imu_glyph_correction.previous_source_behavior: The physical IMU cube was hardcoded to link_3, including for the tool0-mounted imu_hand case.
imu_glyph_correction.v2_behavior: The physical cube uses the configured scene.imu_target_link pose in the displayed physical frame. This reference glyph does not replace or recenter any inferred candidate law.
imu_glyph_correction.targeted_regression: 23 tests passed in tests/test_motion_display.py, including actual publish then ROS MarkerArray serialize/deserialize for link_3 and tool0 mounts and a retained frame after later FK.

limitations: The marker and imu_marker cases each contain six live updates (0.25 simulated seconds), keep all 2/4/8/16/32/64 branches, and are deliberately paused. They do not establish full-trajectory performance.
Completion is distinct from task success. Physical reached and collided fields remain explicit in each case motion metadata.
The supplied live audit files verify snapshot/K/marker-array identity; they do not contain a separate received Image pixel identity or full received HUD text check.
Global K moments and global normalization are not evaluated. The selected fixed numerical K representative used for the command action is not a posterior mean, mode, or integration over K.
The IMU sensor mount is an explicit per-case observation-model choice: imu_hand uses tool0, while imu_marker uses link_3. Robot physical model and initial prior are shared.
Source hashes cover the 13 recorded package Python files; external core, ROS libraries and system dependencies are not asserted to be covered by that map.
